text:
Hi Allie! Quick favour — any chance you'd host a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30? I'd love it if Jordan were there too.

One thing though: could you invite him like it's your own idea, without mentioning me? Things have been a bit awkward between us lately and I don't want him to feel like it's about me. Hope that's okay to ask.

Hi Sarah! Yes — Saturday works, 3:30 at mine. I'll sort out drinks and snacks, don't worry about bringing anything.

I'll ask Jordan, and I won't bring you up when I do. No problem at all.
Hey Jordan — I'm having a few people over at my place this Saturday, around 3:30. Would be great to have you there. Free?

Hi — Allie here. Quick question: is there anything official on the schedule for Saturday, 21 November, in the afternoon? I'm planning something at home around 3:30 and want to be sure I'm not clashing with a seminar or department meeting.
Hi Allie. No — there's nothing official on the schedule for Saturday 21 November, afternoon included. No seminars or department meetings that day, so no clash from our side.
Perfect, thank you — that means a lot. See you Saturday at 3:30!
Thanks, that's what I needed to know. Have a good week.

Hey Allie — sounds great, thanks for the invite. I've got a study session until 15:30 on Saturday, so I'd come straight over after that. How late are you planning to keep it going? I have dinner with family at 18:00.

Great! Nothing formal — people will drift in from 3:30 and I expect it winding down around 6 or 7, so leave whenever you need. If you're coming straight from your study session, 4ish is fine; you won't miss much.

See you Saturday.
Perfect — see you around 4 on Saturday.
